text:
[Council File 26-1118]
Resolution (Price – Soto-Martinez) relative to urging CommonSpirit Health and California Nurses Association (CNA)/National Nurses Organizing Committee (NNOC)/National Nurses United (NNU) to discuss, in good faith, a mutually beneficial strategy to preserve and grow healthcare services jobs and invest in healthcare workers.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Sep 4, 2026); Council action final
